objetivo.en_sus_palabras: I want to build some muscle tone and feel stronger. I'm not trying to compete or become a bodybuilder, just look and feel better about myself.

experiencia.detalle: I've trained at a gym following generic routines from phone apps. I can do the basic exercises with reasonably good technique, but I've never had personalized guidance or a plan tailored to me.

nutricion.contexto: Cooks for herself on weekdays, eats out with friends on weekends. Average budget, no problem buying a variety of foods.

notas_libres: Has tried restrictive diets before (low-carb) and abandoned them after a few weeks because they were hard to maintain socially. Prefers something flexible she can stick to long-term.
